- **International career** — international resume, building a career abroad
- **Startup DevOps transformation** — IaC, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, platform from scratch

## What I take on (engineering, hire)

- **Greenfield infrastructure** — Selectel / AWS / GCP / Yandex Cloud, Terraform + Ansible
- **Kubernetes + GitOps** — vanilla Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD, migration off Docker Swarm or Rancher
- **CI/CD platform** — GitLab CI, Jenkins, Harbor / Artifactory / Nexus
- **Observability & SRE** — Prometheus / VictoriaMetrics / Grafana / ELK / Sentry, alerting, runbooks
- **Security & platform tooling** — Vault, Keycloak, SonarQube, encrypted backups (restic + S3), SOC 2-aligned SDLC

Format: part-time, contract, or project-based / one-off work. Remote, base time zone: Moscow.

## Approach

- Strongly against "interview hacking" schools. I share real knowledge and experience, not scripted answers.
- Outside-in view on real engineering tasks and architecture — broad exposure across many projects.
- Core specialization: CI/CD and the automation around it; experience with high-load systems and observability.

## Selected experience

- **Mar 2025 — present**, project-based: Security MVP (NDA — Selectel, Terraform, Ansible, GitLab,
  SonarQube, Keycloak, Vault, OpenProject, OpenSearch, VictoriaMetrics, restic+S3) and litegallery.io
  (Docker Swarm → Kubernetes via ArgoCD, HPA autoscaling, GitLab CI / ArgoCD / Helm).
- **Jun 2024 — Feb 2025**, MTS / KION (streaming platform): new infra dev/stage/prod with geo-redundancy,
  Helm/Kubernetes microservices, Prometheus/Grafana/ELK observability, Ansible/Terraform.
- **Aug 2022 — Apr 2024**, Azul (Azul JDK): highly-available Jenkins via IaC, Nexus, SOC 2-aligned SDLC,
  AWS spend cut ~×2.
- **Aug 2021 — Jul 2022**, Cyberprotect: Jenkins migration to IaC, build infrastructure relocation.
- **Feb 2019 — Aug 2021**, Wallarm (SDET): FAST DAST scanner and WAF Node release pipelines, OWASP Top 10 testing.

## Common questions (FAQ)

- **How can I find a DevOps mentor?** — Open mentorship platforms (MentorCruise, GetMentor, Codementor) or
  contact a practicing Senior DevOps engineer directly. Eduard runs 1-on-1 DevOps mentoring online via Telegram.
- **Are you available for part-time or contract work?** — Yes. Remote, located in Russia. Kubernetes,
  GitOps, Terraform, AWS / GCP / Yandex Cloud, Python, Go.
- **Can you help with DevOps transformation in a startup?** — Yes — building DevOps practices from scratch
  (IaC, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, security) or accelerating an in-progress transformation.
- **Do you teach how to pass interviews?** — No. I share knowledge and experience, not scripted answers.
  I can run mock interviews and point out real weak spots.
- **What languages do you work in?** — Russian (native), English (B2). Available for international engagements.
